29 years of learning, growing and curiosity 🌱 

When Stephanie Hall joined the business after completing a placement as a student, she found exactly what she was looking for. Nearly three decades later, that curiosity is still driving her every day. 

As part of our Information Services team in our Newcastle Hub, Stephanie helps ensure the industry content our customers rely on is accurate, current, and easy to discover. It's work that requires attention to detail, a passion for learning, and what she calls the ‘detective work’ of finding, reviewing, and organizing information. 

Reflecting on her 29-year journey at Hubexo, Stephanie said:

"I've been really lucky to work with very supportive, knowledgeable and encouraging colleagues throughout my career. They're always willing to share their expertise and help you learn and grow.”

Thank you, Stephanie, for 29 years of dedication, expertise, and passion for what you do 👏

Watch the video to find out more about her journey...

Highlights from AIA26 🌟 

Last month, we spent a brilliant few days at AIA26 in San Diego. The event was packed with valuable conversations, new connections and the chance to showcase our specification platform, Lattira, to architects, specifiers and manufacturers from across North America.

Conversations ranged from AI and BIM integration to specification quality and better-connected workflows, with a strong focus on how technology can help professionals work more effectively.

As Dr Stephen Hamil, Innovation Director, shared:

"What stood out was the appetite for better-connected specification workflows. We had some fantastic conversations, gained valuable feedback and saw strong interest in what we're building at Hubexo."

Thank you to everyone who stopped by our stand, joined our session or shared their perspective. We’re excited to keep the conversation going.

The American Institute of Architects (AIA)
